experiment: Sol medium first UX authoring pass

control.boundary: First UX authoring pass through initial proposal delivery only; no repair, persistence, review or downstream processing.

unitReuseMethod: Nonoverlapping equal JSON subtrees at identical paths; excludes unchanged property-name and punctuation overhead, and does not match moved array entries. Python JSON normalization caveat also applies. Skipped if baseline candidates are ambiguous.
limits: Actor windows overlap and must not be summed.
Marker intervals include tool-call preparation and may cross actors; they are not pure reasoning time.
Per-command streams and previous-result gaps can overlap for concurrent calls; do not sum them as elapsed time. Gaps can include idle time between turns.
Pointer JSON-number normalization may require exact JavaScript rechecking if a verification mismatch is reported.
Model-request observer disabled: wire flags, auxiliary approval requests and wire-based response grouping are unobserved, not zero.
One paired historical comparison changes both model and reasoning effort; no isolated causal estimate or quality equivalence.
Both author windows stop at the first units.finish tool result; later structural repairs in the baseline are excluded.
First-pass usage includes only responses completed by the cutoff and can omit usage finalized just after that tool call.
Command-generation and reasoning-item streams are not pure semantic reasoning measurements.
